script.text: A dueltainer beat me again… How lame.
Aster?! What're you doing?!
What I should've done a long time ago – standing up for what's right.
Instead of fear, Yuya and his dad ducked the tears and brought the cheers. We all need to do a lot more of that.
The people of the Xyz Dimension were doing just fine until we showed up. We took their world and turned it upside down.
It's time for us to face facts and admit that the Professor's project was nothing less than a war of conquest in disguise.
The only decent thing to do is to end the project and work on righting all the wrongs it caused.
Any of you who don't agree with what I'm proposing have my permission to go back to Duel Academy.
But I hope each one of you will find it in your heart to stay here with me and help rebuild what we destroyed.
Thank you.
Glad to have you on board. Now that we're working together, I know we can put a stop to the Professor's pointless war!
Later that day, Aster and Yuya discussed how to get to the Fusion Dimension.
There's a teleportation device located in our headquarters.
So this is where you zap all those cards to the Fusion Dimension?
That's right. From that chamber direct to Duel Academy.
One last thing… Did you get a chance to ask your squad about Zuzu?
Sorry, Yuya. No one's seen her, much less anyone with – and I quote – fab pink hair.
Thanks anyway.
Let's get teleporting.
Yeah. Ready…?
Yeah!
